_comment: POC 5 input pack for the open-state static twin. See docs/pocs/poc5-digital-twin-runbook.md Stage 1. Product: Graco Ready2Jet Kingston. One state per job: all input views show the OPEN stroller; the folded-state image feeds a separate future job.
pack_status: RETIRED 2026-08-14 after the meshy-v1-pilot-run-01 FAIL. Known defects: three conflicting canopy states, no rear view, close-up held-out (silhouette IoU unsatisfiable), view-02 SKU unconfirmed. Pack v2 requirements are listed in evaluation/scorecard-meshy-v1-pilot-run-01.md; v2 must bump pack_version, and every v2 frame must be verified against Kingston 2209064 with the same canopy/seat state and same accessories. Runner records pack_version + pack_hash in every submission.

product.name: Ready2Jet Stroller
product.colorway: Kingston — gray fabric / black frame / tan leather handle grip
product.colorway_note: Corrected 2026-08-14: the collected images are the Kingston gray/tan colorway, i.e. model 2209064 — NOT Splatter Art 2212125 (the model used by the earlier Higgsfield/Seedance POCs). The experiment follows the images. Published dimensions match across both SKUs, but exact-SKU provenance still matters; do not mix assets across the two.

verified_dimensions.status: RECORDED 2026-08-14 from the official Graco specification (identical for 2209064 Kingston and 2212125 Splatter Art).
verified_dimensions.source_url: Official Graco product specification (Ready2Jet); folded dimensions still to be recorded.

LIMITATION (recorded 2026-08-14): this is a close-up, so it can validate local seat/belly-bar geometry only — it CANNOT support the runbook's whole-product silhouette IoU test, which requires an independent global three-quarter view. The global silhouette check is unsatisfiable with the current input pack; resolve by sourcing one more clean global view (PDP scrape or Decision 2 self-capture) before scoring silhouette.

known_accepted_risks: Three different canopy configurations across the four input views (extended / scrunched / collapsed). Canopy region expected to be the messiest; rigid frame is consistent and is what POC 6 needs.
No true rear view — rear geometry is inferred by definition; check 4d watches for hallucinated rear detail.
